audit_items.proof_trace: The application delegates PKCE validation entirely to `supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code)` from `@supabase/ssr ^0.5.1` / `@supabase/supabase-js ^2.45.1`, which transmits the stored `code_verifier` (read from cookies via the server client's cookie handlers) to the Supabase Auth server for validation. The Supabase Auth server enforces SHA256(code_verifier) == stored code_challenge before issuing a session; the application introduces no bypass — there is only one call site for `exchangeCodeForSession`, no `setSession` injection, and the cookie handlers in `server.ts` correctly expose the verifier.
